energy.provenance: All values are authored scenario controls for a transparent arithmetic demonstration, not plant design estimates. Alpha deposition, whole-model neutron/photon heat recovery, gross-cycle efficiency, and on/off auxiliary load are unresolved physically.

base_assumptions.provenance: Authored illustrative control scenario, frozen before production outputs. The selected inventory, reserve, 1-day processing delay, 95% recovery, 30-day annual outages, service trip thresholds, 60-day replacement, and energy conversion assumptions are tunable scenario inputs only. No value is a measured, optimized, or qualified ARC parameter; all inventory, availability, self-sufficiency, materials, thermal-cycle, and net-energy interpretations are conditional. Restart hysteresis is set to 0.6 kg to prevent arbitrarily short fuel-starved restart pulses around the 0.5 kg reserve. Decay constant uses NUBASE2020 Table I, article page 030001-19 (PDF page 20), tritium row, 12.32(2) Julian years.
